signals.summary: arXiv:2610.26913v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The adoption of Large Language Models for radiology report structuring has been largely dominated by either proprietary cloud-based models or large open models requiring high-end GPUs for deployment, which is a critical bottleneck for clinical adoption in radiology workflows that demand data privacy and offline operation. To address this, we present MedPAO-Assist, an edge-deployable agentic framework that generates structured radiology reports directly from radiologist dictation and voice commands, requiring only $\approx3.3$ GB peak RAM and achieving an average end-to-end latency of $\approx31$ seconds on a standard laptop CPU through an asynchronous, multi-threaded execution pipeline. The system currently supports four major imaging modalities -- Chest X-ray, Chest CT, Abdomen CT, and Brain MRI. To our knowledge, it is among the earliest agentic systems to run its entire pipeline with a Small Language Model (SLM) in the 0.6B-parameter range. signals.title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
signals.summary: arXiv:2610.26943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mathematical reasoning is a fundamental capability for educational applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), where reliable problem solving requires not only correct answers but also coherent and verifiable reasoning processes. Multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown growing potential in this domain by leveraging collaboration and verification among multiple LLM agents. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on the correctness of final answers in text-only settings, offering limited insight into multimodal reasoning capabilities, the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, and robustness against reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal mathematical reasoning capabilities of MASs. MAMath-Bench comprises 1,003 problems spanning 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and several modalities, including text, images, and audio. signals.title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
signals.summary: arXiv:2610.28703v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-scale topology optimization (TO) remains computationally demanding, especially for stress-constrained problems. To address this challenge, we propose the simultaneous neural topology optimization (SNTO) framework where we represent state, adjoint, and design variables with custom neural networks (NNs) whose parameters are jointly optimized within a single optimization loop that leverages continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation. This optimization minimizes a multi-component loss function that combines the design objective, an aggregation of the local stress constraints, and the potential energy functionals. Our NNs have a unique architecture that accelerates convergence while enabling the networks to capture sharp gradients and boundaries which are critical to stress-constrained TO. To achieve scalability to millions of degrees of freedom (DoF), we develop a hardware-aware training scheme in which the design domain is partitioned into subdomains that are distributed across multiple GPUs. signals.title: Hurricane Trudy menaces Mexico’s Pacific coast and Greece hit by deadly floods
signals.summary: Trudy weakens to tropical storm after warnings of strong winds and heavy rain, while one person killed in Greece In contrast to the quiet Atlantic hurricane season, there has been ongoing activity in the Pacific, with Trudy being the 22nd and latest named system. The category 2 hurricane remained roughly 100 miles (160km) south-west of the coast of Mexico, meaning the worst of the conditions stayed offshore. However, the US National Hurricane Center put coastal parts of the states of Jalisco, Michoacán and Colima under hurricane warnings, with sustained winds of up to 60-90mph forecast on Sunday. Rainfall totals of 100-150mm were likely for these areas, prompting warnings of flooding and landslides. Warnings also covered the risk of a dangerous storm surge accompanied by damaging waves in areas of onshore winds across the coast of south-western Mexico. By Monday morning, Trudy had weakened and been downgraded to a tropical storm, with coastal warnings being lifted. Continue reading...

themes.reading: Các diễn biến chính trị và thương mại có thể ảnh hưởng đến vận tải, giá đầu vào hoặc quyết định đầu tư. Chưa thể suy ra tác động tới Việt Nam nếu chưa biết tuyến hàng, mặt hàng và mức độ phơi nhiễm.
themes.falsifier: Bác bỏ nếu chưa có thay đổi chính sách/luồng hàng thực tế hoặc mặt hàng liên quan không gắn với Việt Nam.

evidence.title: EU should revive talks on broader China trade deal, top MEP says
evidence.summary: As EU lawmakers prepare to visit Beijing, the European Parliament's trade chief is calling for a broader agreement that could revive elements of a frozen investment pact and address unfair Chinese trade practices across multiple industries.

evidence.title: Sudan conflict: Peace efforts resume to end ‘drone war’ fuelling humanitarian crisis
evidence.summary: Talks to halt the fighting in Sudan and alleviate the humanitarian crisis there continued in Geneva on Wednesday, where nearly two dozen countries convened to discuss a pathway to a ceasefire and transition to peaceful governance that represents all Sudanese people.

themes.title: Việt Nam: chính sách và điều kiện kinh doanh
themes.reading: Chỉ đáng nâng thành tín hiệu khi có văn bản hoặc số liệu gốc, phạm vi áp dụng và nhóm chịu tác động xác định được. Tin kinh doanh đơn lẻ chưa đủ để kết luận xu hướng kinh tế Việt Nam.
themes.falsifier: Bác bỏ nếu không có văn bản/số liệu gốc hoặc nội dung không tạo thay đổi đáng kể với doanh nghiệp.

evidence.title: Trình Quốc hội giải pháp hoán đổi đất ở, bảo đảm sinh kế khi thu hồi đất
evidence.summary: Chính phủ đề xuất người có đất ở bị thu hồi được hoán đổi sang phần đất còn lại hoặc thửa đất khác của mình trong cùng xã, đồng thời bổ sung chính sách hỗ trợ ổn định cuộc sống.

evidence.title: Kỷ lục doanh thu của Phúc Long sau khi về tay Masan
evidence.summary: Phúc Long Heritage, doanh nghiệp vận hành chuỗi trà và cà phê cùng tên, đạt doanh thu 589 tỷ đồng trong quý III, kỷ lục từ khi hợp nhất Masan.

evidence.title: Hỗ trợ doanh nghiệp tối ưu dòng tiền cao điểm cuối năm
evidence.summary: MSB nâng cấp giải pháp M-Flex 2.0 với hạn mức tới 25 tỷ đồng, phê duyệt tự động và giải ngân trong 2-4 giờ hỗ trợ doanh nghiệp chủ động vốn cuối năm.

evidence.title: Nhiều ngân hàng cho vay bình quân trên 11% trước đợt hạ lãi suất
evidence.summary: Techcombank, OCB, TPBank, BVBank… cho khách hàng cá nhân vay lãi suất hơn 11% mỗi năm trước đợt điều chỉnh theo yêu cầu của Ngân hàng Nhà nước.
